Dear Miss Yonge,
We sent the 11 copies to make your dozen by rail the same day that the single copy was sent you by post Feb:27.[I](/person/939) have seen in the parcels book the signature of the clerk at the Golden Cross booking office. I have sent down to enquire about it. Perhaps you could enquire at your end. The address was quite clear Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester I am sending you a copy of the gilt-edged cover by the post.[^1]
Yours very truly
A. Macmillan


[^1]: This refers to [The Pupils of St. John the Divine](/book/72), which was published in one volume, as the first in the [Sunday Library](/topic/145), and advertised as cloth 4s., gilt edges 4s. 6d..
